headline: Sabunçu: spacious suburban district with low public transport coverage and affordable houses

tags.reason: The district provides 4.82 schools per 10,000 residents, exceeding the Baku median of 3.43.
Detached courtyard houses average 900 AZN per square metre compared to the city median of 1,264.5 AZN.

summary: Sabunçu is a low-density suburban district with 1,383 residents per square kilometre against the Baku median of 2,890.5. Its transport index stands at 27 points against the city median of 55.5, with zero metro stations and the nearest station 9.4 km away. Housing affordability ranks above average at 54 points on the index, backed by 3,522 listings where 76% possess a title extract (çıxarış). Education infrastructure performs solidly with an index of 54, offering 2.68 kindergartens per 10,000 residents compared to the municipal benchmark of 2.32.
strengths: Higher density of grocery shops than the city benchmark (17.51 groceries per 10,000 residents; median 13.41)
Above-average school density across the territory (4.82 schools per 10,000 residents; median 3.43)
Lower acquisition cost for detached courtyard houses (900 AZN per m²; median 1,264.5 AZN)
weaknesses: Substantially lower density of public transport stops (2.41 bus stops per 10,000 residents; median 6.22)
Subdued daily amenities and retail score (convenience index 38; median 51.5)
Lower density of primary healthcare and diagnostic facilities (0.84 clinics per 10,000 residents; median 1.22)
best_for: Buyers seeking lower-cost detached courtyard houses (heyət evi) with 76% deeded listings
Households prioritising access to state schools over rapid metro access
watch_out: Daily transit depends on bus routes or 3 rail stations, as the nearest metro station is 9.4 km away
93.1% of the 2,370 km road network lacks mapped surface information, obscuring precise asphalt rates
Land valuation of 14,000 AZN per sot is an unverified mock figure and should not guide decisions
confidence_note: OpenStreetMap coverage is high and per-capita metrics are reliable, but 93.1% of road surfaces remain unclassified. Property pricing draws from a sample of 3,522 listings, whilst land values represent mock demonstration data.
